_comment: Purchasable product records, keyed by catalogue slug (slugify of the agent name on /agents). name and sku are what Stripe, the success page and invoices show. saleApproved=false blocks LIVE-mode checkout for the slug (test-mode keys are unaffected), so enabling a test checkout can never start real sales of an unapproved release. release.package is the R2 object name under agents/<slug>/ that a buyer downloads; release.sha256 must equal the hash of that exact uploaded file (null = not yet published, the success page then omits it). aliases: retired slugs that must keep resolving to this product (old checkout links, Stripe metadata, KV entitlements and certificates written before a rename).
